details:
Hello, I figure devs could benefit from examples of highly broken physbones conversions (inside VRChat for old packages). 
Here's a video of a couple broken examples.
https://youtu.be/WB3-pJcYBZA
I included Unity footage of the dynamic bones setup of the first avatar. The avatar showcased first and in Unity does not use dynamic bone colliders and was uploaded under Unity 2019. Avatar ID if it helps devs: avtr_cb7ef3c3-c305-4e88-be90-d89614eea515 . For the second avatar in the video, the ID is avtr_5ce2ad69-324f-46d5-b92e-25ef8c7b103a . 
I also showcased a number of other examples of avatars' walking animations breaking (the catgirl, avatar ID avtr_003ef930-4a89-4c9f-82c8-190469c8ca07 ), as well as some examples of rotation animations being broken while physbones was enabled (avatar ID avtr_a5b706bd-e014-4495-a700-380715a92416). If the Unity setups help for any of these avatars, let me know and I can get screenshots or another video up.
For common themes between avatar setup, I like to use Inert on a lot of my avatars as well as setup exclusions the same way. High exclusion counts seem to be a common theme on the broken avatars in question.
There are many dozens of other examples of tiny changes, but those are from older versions of Unity and I expect those are more likely to break.
title: [1181] Examples of Highly Broken Physbones conversions
